name: Pico Plaza
demographics: Pico Plaza serves the affluent coastal community of San Clemente, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families and professionals with household incomes above the Orange County median. The trade area draws a mix of local residents aged 35-65, including retirees and young families, who value convenience and quality in their shopping experience. Visitors typically seek neighborhood services, dining options, and specialty retail in a relaxed beach-town atmosphere, with shopping patterns reflecting the area's upscale coastal lifestyle and preference for boutique experiences over big-box retail.
description: Pico Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center located at 109 Via Pico Plaza in the heart of San Clemente, California, one of Orange County's most desirable coastal communities. Managed by The REMM Group, a respected commercial property management firm with an extensive portfolio throughout Southern California, Pico Plaza serves as a convenient retail destination for local residents and visitors alike. The center operates daily from 5:30 AM to 10:00 PM, providing extended hours to accommodate the busy schedules of the San Clemente community. With a strong 4.5-star rating based on over 500 Google reviews, Pico Plaza has established itself as a trusted neighborhood gathering place. The center's prime location on Via Pico Plaza positions it within easy reach of San Clemente's residential neighborhoods, offering a mix of retail, dining, and service-oriented tenants that cater to the daily needs of this affluent beach community.
summary: Pico Plaza is a well-regarded neighborhood shopping center in San Clemente, California, managed by The REMM Group. With a 4.5-star rating and convenient daily hours, it serves as a trusted retail destination for the local coastal community.
